subject: WRITE statement
notes: kb/Work PB1190 landed (w67p). cite.py --check 14.9.51.4 'shall not be larger than the largest or smaller than the smallest number of bytes allowed by the RECORD IS VARYING clause' -> OK §14.9.51.4 14). The WRITE's length decision is ONE member (WrittenLength) asked by both arms, and the bound (OutsideVaryingBounds) runs in both - the print-control arm (WriteAdvancingRecord, which a print/LINAGE file's plain WRITE is rerouted to) now receives the DEPENDING length through FileRegistry.WriteAnyOrg.
